steps.description: Load PDDL domain and problem files using unified_planning PDDLReader

suggestions: Use unified_planning.io.PDDLReader().parse_problem(domain_path, problem_path) to load both files.

steps.description: Generate a plan using OneshotPlanner with pyperplan

suggestions: Use OneshotPlanner(name='pyperplan').solve(problem) and handle the case where no plan is found.

steps.description: Save the validated plan to disk in correct PDDL format using PDDLWriter

failure_patterns.reason: ❌ str(action) produces wrong PDDL format 'action(args)' instead of '(action args)'. Use PDDLWriter.write_plan() instead.
❌ Manually writing plan files bypasses PDDLWriter and produces incorrect PDDL syntax. Use PDDLWriter.write_plan() instead.
❌ Using echo to write plan files produces invalid PDDL format. Use PDDLWriter.write_plan() instead.

suggestions: Use unified_planning.io.PDDLWriter().write_plan(plan, output_path) — this is the only safe way to produce valid PDDL action syntax '(action arg1 arg2)'.
warnings: PDDLWriter may emit comment lines (e.g., '; sequential plan') in the output — verify the verifier accepts or strip them if required.
